jobs.prompt: 2D anime, hand-drawn cel animation, static locked framing, the frame never moves, flat cel shading, clean ink linework, anime key art. Subject already in frame: ONE adult man alone, dark cropped hair, round wire-rim glasses on his face, standing in bright daylight with deep tall grass behind him. HIS HAND IS AT HIS FACE AND STAYS THERE: his curled fingers rest against his mouth with the thumb under his chin, the knuckles and fingers drawn whole against his lips, and they stay resting there the whole time, shifting a little against his mouth as he thinks. HIS FACE WORKS THROUGH A THOUGHT, SLOWLY: his brows draw together and then ease, his eyes shift and settle, his head tilts a few degrees.
